name: calf stretch with rope
description: A calf stretch where you use a rope to help pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf and the back of the lower leg.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a rope or strap around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg to a comfortable height, keeping the knee softly bent if needed.
Pull the strap gently to draw the toes toward you until you feel a mild calf stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, release slowly, then switch legs.
